reviews.author: Louise CB
reviews.text: I went here for Sunday lunch on a recommendation from a friend, and it easily turned out to be the best roast I’ve ever had. I usually find roasts out a bit disappointing, but every component  was cooked to perfection - I loved the carrot and swede. The beef was absolutely delicious, and the milk tart is not to be missed either. The staff were lovely, the atmosphere was great, and I’ll definitely be back when next in Manchester!

reviews.author: Craig Johnson
reviews.text:
We visited recently and thought this was very good. Not 5* excellent, but very, very good and for those of you who don't mind reviews that are different to "this was the best place ever, 5*" or "shocking, don't go, 1*", then hopefully this is useful.

It's a small plates menu (except for their Sunday lunch, which we would recommend as 5*). I've tried to get on board with small plates, but I've yet to be persuaded that the priority is anything other than to make you pay more for a full portion of food than if you just ordered a main meal. When the response to "no we've not been here before" is "OK I'll just explain the menu to you", I'm just not persuaded that small plates is really a good thing.

One main meal? Brilliant.
3-4 small tapas? Beautiful.
A small plate for 2-3 carrots for not much short of £10? Hm. Sorry, no.

There were 3-4 "big small plates". Tbh, I'd have rather just had any one of these as a main meal, with the best smaller plates as a starter.

That being said, rant over... the food was very good. It's comparable in quality to Stretford Canteen and Pip, but probably a little cheaper than SC and probably a more generous portion than Pip.

Another comparison would be Higher Ground. It's a bit cheaper than their set menu, but the quality and originality at HG is much, much higher. This food was generally very good quality, but there wasn't a vast amount that a very good cook couldn't prepare at home.

A minor gripe again about the carrots. They're so cheap. The expense of a carrot dish is the skilled staff time. They're a perfect restaurant ingredient because they're cheap but they're fantastic prepared with skill like at 10 Tib Lane. If you're going to charge so much for a carrot dish, give us a few more carrots please.

The puddings were good. The cheese, pear and spiced bread was beautiful. But the rhubarb wasn't tart enough to go with a sweet biscuit and a sweet mousse.

We loved the wine list and the generous "No/Low" alcohol menu. I'd have loved one more non-alcoholic beer option for those that don't enjoy German-style lager. There are some excellent 0.5% pale ales and IPAs by Manchester breweries (or Guinness 0.0 is great too).

So all in all, very good. But we'll probably only be going back for their (absolutely superb) Sunday lunch or a drink.

reviews.author: Alex Draghici
reviews.text:
Toopak on the bar is a sweetheart, all of the staff is very friendly and professional.
The oysters (during happy hour!) are the best deal in town period, and their broad selection of vermouths is a sight for sore eyes. You can have whatever variation of the martini or the Manhattan that you could possibly want.

reviews.author: Liberté
reviews.text:
The raw scallop was not fresh and it had a very strong fishy smell. It’s not acceptable to serve such an unfresh scallop when they are charging £14 for one scallop sliced into several pieces. The scallop didn’t go with the cucumber either. It’s also alarming that the chef who prepared this dish didn’t think they shouldn’t have served such a smelly scallop.

As for the service, it wasn’t attentive nor was it friendly. The server collected the plate without asking if everything was okay, so we couldn’t tell her that the scallop was bad.

Two star is for the veggies that came with the roast. They were actually quite good except the roast potatoes that were stale. Definitely not worth being in the Michelin guide. I wouldn’t recommend.

reviews.author: Anna Condon
reviews.text: We had a fantastic meal here. Staff were very personable and professional. Highly recommend a visit! Didn’t take many photos but presentation of all dishes was excellent, and everything was very tasty!

reviews.author: Aziz Abwah
reviews.text:
Went to 10 Tib Lane yesterday (Sunday) with my friends there were five of us, and we all had the Sunday Roast.
Honestly, it was the best Sunday Roast I’ve had so far! The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and the service was great 👌🏼
The only thing I didn’t like was the dessert at the end it didn’t quite match the level of the main course.
But overall, I’d highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Rob Pridham
reviews.text: We went for dinner based on recommendations without knowing much about the place. We had a mix of small plates and the larger mains, all shared. It was great! The duck in particular was excellent, and the rhubarb dessert was very good too. Cocktails were tasty including the Toucan, a rum twist on an Old Fashioned. Service from Bex was excellent - very friendly and down to earth, attentive without fussing. All in all, a very nice evening, placing it high up amongst Manchester restaurants.

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.text:
I love it here.
I come all the time for food and/or drinks. Every time the staff and experience is brilliant.
The cocktails are unique and inventive.
They also do happy hour on the cocktails and oysters!
Food is lovely and creative too.
They change the menus seasonally, which means you get to try lots of different stuff each time you visit.

title: Moose
address: York House, 20 York St, Manchester M2 3BB

reviews.author: Eddy A
reviews.text:
Well this was our second attempt to come here as there was no space last time. It was definitely worth the wait. Attentive members of staff, no time wasting, food arrived quickly, no harassment. Just nice and chilled.

Loads of Canadian style options on the menu, l am not quite there yet with pancakes, waffles, french toast and maple syrup but l found something l could handle. Maybe next time. Looking around at other people’s plates the food looked so good full joy for your eyes.

I ordered scrambled eggs, granary toast (door stopper slices but still managed to finish it) with a side of streaky bacon and a side of grilled halloumi. Just lovely. May have to venture into the French toast, waffles and maybe pancakes to see what all the love for them is about. Not yet though preparing to go to a wedding 😬

Again our hosts were great, the first person who took around order was excellent he didn’t even write it down, then there was she Abbie was lovely she had a nice warm demeanour, helpful and very attentive.

I would definitely recommend. Moose for breakfast.

reviews.author: Melissa Goodale
reviews.text: Absolutely delicious food and generous portions too.  The coffee was excellent, definitely the best coffee we've had in Manchester. A special shout out to Amy and Jamie for the fantastic service - you balanced being attentive without being intrusive. And thankyou to Matti for the great food, we will be back for more before the end of our trip.

reviews.author: Andrew Dines
reviews.text:
We recently visited Moose Coffee in Manchester for breakfast, and it was absolutely fantastic! If you are looking for an authentic, hearty, North American-style brunch, this is the place to be. The food was so good we couldn't wait to get stuck in, and the staff were extremely friendly and welcoming from the moment we walked in.

​The portions are generous and everything tasted incredible. Here is what we had:

​The Breakfast Burger: A massive, towering brioche bun packed with sausage patties, thick streaky bacon, and perfectly melted cheese. It came served with a generous helping of their famous house potato hash and pickles on the side. We also ordered an extra side of their hearty, thick sausages, which were cooked to perfection.

​The Loaded Bagel: We also had a toasted bagel packed with savory meat, sliced tomato, and oozing with melted cheese. It was served alongside a really fresh rocket side salad drizzled with a balsamic glaze and some extra pickles to cut through the richness.

​Vegan Hot Chocolate: I also had their vegan hot chocolate, and I have to say it was hands down the best hot chocolate I've ever tasted!

​Everything was fresh, piping hot, and hit the spot perfectly. The atmosphere was incredibly relaxed, making it the perfect spot to start the day.

​If you're in Manchester and love a proper, filling breakfast with fantastic service, Moose Coffee is an absolute must-visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sam Beirne
reviews.text:
What can I say? This place was as close to perfection as you can get. Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and the portions were incredibly generous.

We arrived at around 11:00 a.m. and were greeted by a queue of about 12 people, all waiting in the middle of a heatwave. Thankfully, we didn't have to wait too long, and once we got inside, we could see exactly why it's so popular.

The service was friendly and efficient, the location was excellent, and the food was outstanding from start to finish. I honestly couldn't fault the experience.

One tip: if you're planning to visit, I'd recommend making a reservation, especially at busy times. It's definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Chelsea MacRae
reviews.text: Brilliant, friendly service Sophie was polite relaxed and informative. Loved the relaxed vibe yet food is done quite quick. Perfect if you’re in a rush. Michael was our chef we have classic pancakes with streaky bacon and a side of strawberries and double Dutch pancakes with the moose macchiatos everything tasted AMAZING!!!!! First time here and we will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ellen Markham
reviews.text:
Amazing place to eat and friendly staff. Served by Phoebe and the chef for the day was Mike. Every staff member we spoke to was great 👍🏼.
We had the Kaepernick and the fab five Freddy, both so nice.
Will definitely be back on our next visit to Manchester.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text:
Excellent cafe in Manchester. I chose this place as it was rated high for gluten free and I was not disappointed. As soon as we walked through the door we were greeted by the host who asked if any of us had allergies, then gave me a GF menu.
First time ive not felt annoying for asking about allergies!
The food was really quick and came out hot. The quality and taste was next level, so so nice. Coffee great too.
All the staff were genuinly friendly.
Highly recommend this place for anyone who has to eat GF, you wont be disappointed.

reviews.author: alexandra waldock
reviews.text: The food and drinks are amazing. Definetly recommend to anyone who wants a special breakfast. And would like to say a huge thank you to Sophie for excellent service and Dani for cooking a extrondinary meal.

reviews.author: Multi Vitamins
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our meal, which featured incredibly fresh and authentic flavors along with very generous serving sizes.

The food was outstanding; I would 100% recommend the ravioli, which was cooked to perfection with a flavorful, creamy sauce. The cheesy, crispy arancini were equally delicious, especially with the accompanying dipping sauce. To finish, we had the tiramisu, which was easily the best I have ever tasted. On a related note, the limoncello spritz was a highlight and truly reminded us of the Amalfi Coast.

Beyond the food, the atmosphere was relaxed, and your staff were remarkably friendly, warm, and attentive. Your restaurant is truly a hidden gem, and we will definitely be back soon to explore more of the menu and enjoy the tiramisu once again.

reviews.author: Babbledomia
reviews.text: Solo lunch al fresco on a summer's day in Manchester. Took the linguine on the chef's special for mains, the bruschetta for starters was juicy - all the right balance of flavours. Sat outside to catch some rays and didn't disappoint, music was a good mix of Italian vibes. There's not too much traffic out and could easily imagine yourself somewhere else on a different island. Will be back 100%.

reviews.author: Toby Reid
reviews.text: Fabulous little restaurant - service was amazing from the staff and the starters were brilliant. We had the arancini and the meatballs then the carbonara and one of the specials. Food was great however we found the pasta a little too al dente - still very enjoyable. Decor was lovely as-well - we’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Anna T
reviews.text:
Hidden away from the chaos of the main streets with lovely decor and service.
I had the seafood pasta, the cream was delicious however I could tell the seafood wasnt fresh and tasted like frozen mixed.
The lasagne was ok.
Reasonable prices for Manchester with great service but the rating doesnt reflect the actual quality.

reviews.author: Nadia Moshkina
reviews.text: I had a great time! Food was outstanding and service was excellent! Huge thank you to Millie and Mariano for taking such a good care of me:) They were attentive, helpful and very polite! Definitely will be back soon!

reviews.author: Vince Agius
reviews.text: We visited Vincenzo Trattoria in Manchester last Saturday. We had no reservation but Stefano, the host, greeted us with a smile and politely asked us if we could wait 15 minutes. We accepted, since we just turned up..... The wait lasted 7 minutes and we were served with great kindness by Stefano. I wish I could give 'Service' above more than 5 stars !! We will surely dine again at Vincenzo especially if Stefano is there...... Complimenti Stefano !!! E grazie mille per la Vostra Cortesia..... Alla prossima !!

reviews.author: Whiskey_n_ryan
reviews.text:
***lovely authentic Italian food served by very polite and knowledgeable staff***

We traveled to Manchester for the day and stopped in this restaurant for some dinner. Our waiter Mariano was very attentive to us, talking is through the menu and the specials and making sure to clear my order with the kitchen with regards to food allergies.

When the food arrive it was devine. The food was full of flavour and the portions were fantastic for what you paid. My partner doesn't eat that much so she ordered a starter size meal for her main dish and this was completely fine with the restaurant.

After we had eaten and were waiting for our deserts, Mariano was talking to us about how our food was and what we had planned for the rest of the day. He was charming and seemed to genuinely listen to us and offer some recommendations in the area. At no point did I feel like it was forced or that we were a burden to him for asking more questions about the food or the local area.

All in all, this was a lovely place to visit, with great food and great service. A quiet atmosphere for the most part too which really helped us to enjoy our meal. We will definitely be back next time we are in Manchester for the day.

reviews.author: Evelyn Hurst
reviews.text: My partner and I went for a very special date night and we were very pleased with the overall experience. The steak was lovely, as was the sausage pasta. They gave us a complimentary birthday dessert as well which was wonderful. They were mostly brilliant with allergies, just a small hiccup when my coffee came with a nutty biscuit on the side. However, the way it was sorted by the manager showed us how professional the management is. Thank you very much!

reviews.author: LAUREN NOVAK
reviews.text:
Our third time visiting Manchester Hawksmoor, it won’t be our last. It’s definitely a treat for us but the food and experience is always amazing.
We can for our 1st wedding anniversary which I had put on the online booking. Both the lady on the main door and our waitress were both aware of this and congratulated us which was really nice.
We went on a Saturday and ordered from the lunch menu which is a really good price for the quality of the food.
We both had the Caeser salad starter which is the best in the world and you could definitely have this for main.
We both had the rump steak, beef dripping chips and a sauce each. Both cookies perfectly to our liking. The sear and crust on the steak is 11/10 delicious. We shared mushrooms and mac and cheese too which we probably didn’t need but ate the whole lot. Every mouthful was delicious. We were too full for a dessert but our waitress brought us a lovely dessert to share with Happy 1st Anniversary on it which was delicious on very thoughtful.
We love it here, it’s our go to for a posh meal out and perfect for celebrating!

reviews.author: Paige
reviews.text: Best service from Matt! The food was amazing, as always. I went on my own for my birthday and was pleasantly surprised with a complimentary dessert and a glass of wine. Such a thoughtful gesture that made my day even more special. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Leonardo
reviews.text:
We chose the set menu and had a really enjoyable meal. The food was well cooked, the portions were generous and everything arrived at a good pace. What stood out most was the service: genuinely welcoming, attentive throughout and very professional without being over the top.

The only thing worth knowing is that sauces for the meat are ordered separately, so the final bill can be a little higher than you may expect from the menu price. It is not necessarily unreasonable, but it would be clearer if this was more explicit. Overall, though, a very good experience and a place I would happily return to.

reviews.author: Massimo Bianco
reviews.text: James was our server for today and he was absolutely fantastic from the moment we arrived to the moment we left. We were celebrating my birthday and my dad’s birthday and it was a lovely treat. Food was sensational, service was brilliant, and the atmosphere was fantastic. I couldn’t recommend this place enough for a Sunday dinner

reviews.author: Ela Yuce
reviews.text:
We had an amaaazing meal here. We came to celebrate a graduation, and Josh served us, and he was so lovely and nice. He was beyond helpful, and the service was top notch.
We ordered the tomato salad with the whipped ricotta, the filet mignons, with the béarnaise sauce and fries. They were all cooked to perfection and tasted delicious, we honestly enjoyed it so much.
They also then offered us brown butter bourbon cookies to celebrate the graduation, and they were so delicious too.
I would recommend this place to every person for any occasion, and you’ll be in good hands.
Dying to go back already!!😻😻

reviews.author: Ian Tolley
reviews.text: Excellent experience and really lucky to get a last minute booking. Booked at 2pm last Friday for 4 people at 4.45pm same day. We were given an early bird option which was incredible value for money. So happy with everything including quality and choice, it definitely exceeded expectations. 100% will be returning. This place is a must when visiting Manchester.

reviews.author: Mark Lee
reviews.text:
Went for a celebratory lunch with the family and the first time for all of us at this Steakhouse.
Amber was excellent with her customer service delivery and staff did check in on us at various times to make sure everything was good.
No issues with the food at all.
All came out well presented, hot and tasty.
Lovely vibe in the restaurant and we all thoroughly enjoyed our time there.

reviews.author: karen Pilling
reviews.text: My husband and I celebrated my birthday here a couple of days ago. It was our first time. The staff were knowledgeable and advised us about the steaks available and what would be suitable. The restaurant soon became busy for a Monday evening. The food was delicious, the atmosphere was warm and friendly and the food was lush.

reviews.author: mark kay
reviews.text:
We fancied going for a Sunday roast, had a look on Google and found Blacklock. On arriving it’s based in a cellar, which the setting was very nice. we chose cocktails for the drinks, which were sublime, I had beef ribs for starter and the wife had crayfish cocktail. Which were delicious. For the main,we went for the Sunday roast sharer, which was massive and definitely recommend. You get 3 meats, lamb, beef and pork. All were cooked perfectly. The service was very warm, friendly and attentive. Keep up the good work. We will be back to try the steaks and burgers soon 😃
Give it a try.

reviews.author: Kamil
reviews.text:
Had a really lovely experience at Blacklock Manchester. The receptionist was very kind and welcoming, and my server Joseph was excellent — professional, friendly, chatty, and very helpful with recommendations for food and drinks.
The restaurant is beautiful, with a cosy and homely atmosphere, and everyone made me feel very welcome. It was also lovely to see the manager doing check-backs, which added a really personal touch.
The food was absolutely delicious — I ordered the fillet steak medium rare and it was excellent. The Broccoli & Walnut Salad was especially incredible as well. Overall, a fantastic experience with great hospitality, and I would definitely recommend it

reviews.author: ali eren Balikel
reviews.text:
We went to Manchester for business trip with my colleagues for 4 days.
We tried different restaurants every time when we had our dinner and lunch.
Particularly this one has beeen the best experience in Manchester.I know this place from London.
I have been to couple of their branch there .
I like the steaks and burger there.Atmosphere is not bad.
Service was very good apart from the girl who brought the drinks.

We were 6 of us and we all had different type of steaks and also burger.

They were all so tasty.service is standard in every branches of black lock.
Therfore you don’t need to be scared.
Over all it was great experience with my colleagues

Recommended

reviews.author: Chris Brown
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic meal at Blacklock Manchester. The steak and chips were cooked perfectly and were some of the best we've had. The "say when" cheesecake with berry coulis is a must.

The atmosphere is really cool—relaxed, lively, and full of character—which made the whole experience even better.

A special mention goes to Danny, our waiter, who was absolutely amazing. He was friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Combined with the incredible food and great service, it was an outstanding dining experience.

We'll definitely be back and would highly recommend Blacklock to anyone looking for excellent steak in Manchester!

reviews.author: Kate Allcroft
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved our visit to blacklock for Sunday dinner.
Food came out super fast and the beef was cooked to perfection!
The roast potatoes were the crispiest I’ve had in a restaurant!
Only pointer would be to fill the gravy bowl higher from the beginning (we are northerners)
All the staff were so lovely and gave a great wine recommendation :) will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Rachael Parry
reviews.text: We celebrated my husband’s birthday here on Monday afternoon and it truly exceeded all expectations. The food, the staff, the atmosphere, it was absolutely perfect. We would definitely return. The smoked rib starter is a must! Thanks to everyone for making my husbands birthday meal special.

reviews.author: Daisy Buchanan-Smith
reviews.text: We LOVE Blacklock! We come every time we have a special occasion and came back for both our birthdays and to celebrate our new house. Was amazing as per, Blacklock is our death row meal and we’ve sent a whole load of people to try. Amazing margaritas, pigs head on toast and steak. We took the cheesecake home for pud and got that free along with the cutest decorated plate and Prosecco. Josef was amazing and can only thank him so much for his lovely service! We love you Blacklock!!!

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.text: 10/10 would recommend. Sirloin steak was outstanding. If you like peppercorn sauce you have to get the chop sauce it was delicious. Staff were so helpful and friendly. The icing on the cake, after testing out espresso martinis in a number of cocktail bars over the weekend, Blacklock’s were by far the best.

reviews.author: Maggy Moyo
reviews.text: The food was amazing Luc and Patrick were super amazing. I took my brother out from Guernesey and he thought I could not impress him with seafood but he bowed🤣, we had to order second plates. Thank you so much to the bar man who was on shift as well.

reviews.author: Elena Ridings
reviews.text: Had a great time at bottomless brunch! We managed to get lots of drinks each which was well worth the money! Food was great too. Our server Delfino was great, super lovely & very accommodating. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Leon Langrish
reviews.text: Came here for the bottomless brunch with a group of us and had a great time. Food was really nice, served fairly quickly too. Cocktails are as expected, lots of variety and very tasty. We tried a few and all were great. Some sweet some sour. Had a great time. Service was also brilliant, all the staff were very friendly and drinks served quickly so thanks to all, and obviously must be a great team behind the bar too.

reviews.author: Sofia Gomes
reviews.text: It was a chill vibe. We were well served. Delfino was 10/10, very attentive and always bringing drinks to our table. The food was quite nice too. We had some burguers. My fav cocktail was the Raspberry Reggae.

reviews.author: Rachel Whitaker
reviews.text: Had gorgeous food and cocktails here with my friend. The food and the service never disappoints. We were looked after by Izzy and Amy and they were both friendly, professional and quick with service. Definitely be back again soon.

reviews.author: chloe pacitto
reviews.text: Came for a bottomless brunchand the best time. Imogen was so nice and always knew when we needed more drinks. Will be back again. Food was 10/10.

reviews.author: CD 23
reviews.text: We stumbled across Turtle Bay completely by accident. My daughters had grabbed some of their jerk fried chicken and chips as a takeaway while we were having a drink outside at a local bar nearby. It was so incredibly good that we knew we had to come in for proper dinner!Upon arrival, we were greeted by Luke. He was incredibly friendly, warm, and welcoming. We originally intended to just grab a quick bite, but his fantastic energy convinced us to stay for a full dinner and a few cocktails.A massive thank you to Luke for making our night so special. He is an absolute asset to the team and a great host! We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Dorian Fourie
reviews.text:
Hot Mango Crispy wings (plus a cocktail or two… because I can).

Wings themselves? Proper crispy and seriously tasty. No complaints there.

But the “Hot Mango” sauce… bit of a letdown. I was expecting that punchy fruity mango hit with a bit of heat behind it — and it just never showed up. No real sweetness, no real spice… just kind of sat in the middle.

That said, the atmosphere was spot on, service was bang on (Imogen is super friendly) and the cocktails definitely pulled their weight.

Would I go back? For the vibes and drinks — absolutely. Wings… maybe I’d try a different flavour

title: Exhibition
address: St George's House, 56 Peter St, Manchester M2 3NQ

reviews.author: Hanuma Raj
reviews.text: We had an amazing evening here and everything was perfect. The restaurant had a really classy and cosy atmosphere that made us feel relaxed straight away. The staff were outstanding so kind, helpful and attentive. They made us feel very welcome and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. The food was absolutely incredible. Every course arrived quickly and looked beautiful. The presentation was so impressive that we spent ages taking photos. The taste was even better. Every dish was full of flavour cooked perfectly and made with high-quality ingredients. The desserts were especially amazing. A truly unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: Tinnie
reviews.text:
A solid dining experience with some standout dishes, though a few items could be lighter on seasoning.

1️⃣BKK Diner’s Club
Raw bass — 4.6/5
Very well balanced in flavour and definitely my favourite dish of the night. Highly recommend.

Mango sticky rice ice lolly — 4.2/5
Love the concept and the flavour was really enjoyable. The presentation could be improved a little though, it currently looks a bit like a corndog with ketchup and mustard, which might be intentional

2️⃣Morejoy
Soft shell crab — 4/5
Crispy and well fried, and it pairs nicely with the ginger scallion sauce. However, the seasoning was quite heavy towards the end.

Beef short ribs — 4/5
Very tender and the garlic sauce helps reduce the oiliness. That said, the overall seasoning at Morejoy runs quite strong, which left me pretty thirsty afterwards, and the garlic aroma lingered for a while after the meal.

French toast — 3.9/5
Really tasty and gives strong Hong Kong style vibes. The red bean paste and condensed milk combination made it quite sweet and slightly repetitive towards the end. Best to share between 3 to 4 people so it does not feel too heavy

3️⃣Anatra
Arancini — 4/5
Generous portion with a slight kick from the chilli aioli. Great for sharing.

Pesto spaghetti with confit duck yolk — 3.8/5
Nice presentation and very Instagram worthy, but flavour wise it was decent rather than memorable.

It’s dog friendly!!A plus!

reviews.author: Izzy Creative247
reviews.text: The food was nice, very small portions but not bad. The staff were very friendly and lovely to talk to. The best dish was the white rabbit jelly and pink custard, highly recommend. Some of the other dishes were slightly lack luster but overall a pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Martin Greenwood
reviews.text:
Amazing experience. Service was top notch and everyone so friendly and attentive. Food was outstanding

Raw bass is like ceviche but thai flavours
Salt beef salad bought us back to phuket
Arancini amazing and sauce good balance
Smashed cucumber salad all balanced
Beef short rib was so soft and flavourful
Soft shell crab was stand out dish and so amazing even without dipping sauce
Rota so soft and flavourful
Venison pasta was a let down as sauce was underseasoned and watery
Mago stick rice ice lolly - 1st bit confusing but then 2nd bite was wow and so refreshing like a palette cleanser

Cocktails so good, spicy mescal special should be permanent feature, and clementine daiquiri I loved a lot

Will be back for sure as all was so fast, flavourful and amazing

reviews.author: Christos Tapeinos
reviews.text:
Polite and professional personnel.
The food was either very spicy, or very sour or completely indifferent. This a personal opinion and does not mean the food is not good. However, having been to several countries trying different restaurants I can say that Exhibition can definitely do better.

reviews.author: Kathryn Holdsworth
reviews.text: Amazing place. Love the concept and did not disappoint. Fantastic food and cocktails were divine. Server super helpful 👌  highly recommend going. Soft shell crab 🦀 superb

reviews.author: Rich Tyrrell
reviews.text:
We went for a team lunch on a Wednesday and had a great atmosphere and the variety of menu options really pleased everyone - despite having some different food taste among the group…

We have to say the food was 10 / 10 every single dish and we were very very pleased with how good it was and would definitely go back soon.

Love the fact they have new options sometimes - so it keeps it fresh and different.

Particular favourites for us were kitchens Anatra and MoreJoy, and dishes were the Short rib and the Arancini balls — plus the pasta which were all amazing! Just take a look at the pictures, wow!!

reviews.author: Halle W
reviews.text: We ordered from Anatra and the food was delicious. For the quality of the food the prices were reasonable and the service was prompt. The atmosphere of the venue was exactly what we had hoped. The music was good and was not too loud so when we were sitting we could still hear our conversation. We loved this place and would definitely come back again to try the other vendors or even just for drinks.

reviews.author: Multi Vitamins
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience, and I wanted to personally thank your team for such a memorable evening.

The atmosphere was wonderful, successfully balancing a lively energy with a unique, elegant style that remained very relaxed. We found the food to be outstanding; every dish and small plate we shared was packed with flavor. In particular, the freshly made naan was excellent and the portion sizes were perfect for sharing.

Furthermore, I would like to commend your staff for their friendly and attentive service. Despite the restaurant being quite busy, the evening felt very well-organized, and we greatly appreciated the thoughtful menu recommendations provided by the team.

It was a brilliant experience overall, and we look forward to returning the next time we are in Manchester.

reviews.author: Asher
reviews.text:
We were a large group and were given tasting platters.
The starters were good. The mincemeat dish was the best, nicely spiced. The fried okra was also good.
With the mains, the black lentils stood out. Clearly cooked for an extended period of time with plenty of butter and cream, it was pretty decadent. The ruby chicken was very good too, tomatoey and creamy, maybe could have done with more spice. The raita was nice and refreshing. The seekh kebabs could have been better, a bit too dry. The potatoes were not bad.

Dessert would have been better if it were homemade rather than prepackaged. I had mango kulfi ice cream.

The total price per person came out quite high but that included drinks.

reviews.author: Léo Sezam
reviews.text:
Delicious menu, with very creative and interesting flavours. The meat is very tender🙌

The Naans are good but not the best I’ve had.
I’d say however, that it’s a little too pricey overall though.
For instance, the house chai was delicious (the spices tickle your throat nicely, exactly what I’m looking for) but the portion was too minimal for the price.

For the experience, the unique atmosphere and top quality food, I highly recommend you try at least once in your life.

reviews.author: Christina 1010
reviews.text: We had an excellent meal at Dishoom, all the dishes and Drinks were delicious. The staff were very attentive and friendly. Our waiter took plenty of time to explain the menu and was always on hand to take orders and check that we had everything we needed.

reviews.author: V M
reviews.text:
Mine was a delivery order.

Packaging was amazing.
My order was delivered quickly.
But I feel the items are a bit pricey.

1. Masala paratha- I felt it was dry and a bit burnt.

2. Chole- spice level was very mild. Good portion.

3. Date Tamarid chutney- yet to taste. So unable to comment on it but i liked the idea of selling it along our normal order which made me think to attempt its taste.

4. Samosa - was good and provided with sauce

reviews.author: T Rank
reviews.text:
Dishoom Manchester completely lived up to the hype and is 100% worth the visit. It was recommended to us and after seeing all the reviews, it felt like a must- and it did not disappoint.
We went as a group of four and were seated right away, which was a great start. The place is much bigger than it looks from the outside, with a really cool atmosphere and great vibes throughout.
The staff was super friendly and very knowledgeable about the menu, helping us navigate all the options.
The menu is packed with great choices, so we decided to share a bunch of dishes to try as much as possible. We ordered the dahi batata puri, chili chicken, lamb samosas, vegetable samosas, chicken tikka, gunpowder potatoes, chicken ruby, Goan monkfish curry, chicken biryani, garlic naan (highly recommend one per person), masala paratha, and steamed basmati rice, along with some drinks.
Every single dish was cooked perfectly, full of flavor, and came out at a great pace.
Everything felt fresh, well-seasoned, and authentic. The portions were perfect for sharing and left all four of us completely satisfied.
Overall, this is a top-tier spot for Indian food in Manchester with amazing food, great service, and a fun atmosphere.
I would highly recommend it and would absolutely come back the next time I’m in the city.

reviews.author: Melanie Seaton
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at Dishoom! The food was fabulous, atmosphere was lovely and the service was fantastic - a special thank you to Michaela who looked after us so well and made it a really great experience (and has fantastic hair). We would recommend this place to anyone and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Jean Paul Ramírez
reviews.text: This was truly an amazing experience. The atmosphere was quite loud, ngl, but also really immersive? Like a weird sensory trip. The food was delicious: we got the chef’s special biryani, which was amazing! We also got the bhel, butter chicken, paneer, and raita. The service was fantastic as well. The food was delicious, and I don’t think the prices were overwhelming, especially since we were sharing!

reviews.author: Pritha Razad
reviews.text:
Had an early dinner at El Gato Negro during my visit to Manchester and really enjoyed the overall experience. The restaurant has a beautiful setting with a warm, stylish atmosphere, making it a lovely place to relax over a meal. The service was friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome.

The food was good overall and I enjoyed most of the dishes we ordered. The only one that wasn’t quite for me was the chorizo, which I found a little too salty. Aside from that, everything was well prepared, and I’d happily come back to try more of the menu.

reviews.author: roy meesschaert
reviews.text:
Would definitely recommend! I had the padron peppers, olives, jamon croquetas, gambas pil pil and the manchego and chorizo tortilla. I finished my meal with the Basque cheesecake.
All the dishes were tasty and flavourful.
I had a seat at the bar where I could see the chefs preparing my food which was also nice.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.text: Had a booking here, wasn't quite sure where to wait for my table - staff weren't too welcoming I'm afraid. They do tell you that the portions are small - I was actually relatively full from eating a main and a side. They have a lot of barstool type seating, which I found extremely uncomfortable. I also thought it was a touch too warm inside on a summer evening, but that might just be me. I found the food to be average, nothing special. There would have been 12.5% service charge, but I asked to have it removed - the waiter did not point it out to me, which I think should be standard, especially in an upscale place! It wasn't a terrible experience, but definitely a letdown for me given the prices.

reviews.author: Rish S
reviews.text: So good we had to return twice in 2 days! The lunch deal works out great value for money - 3 tapas dishes for £20. Staff were super friendly. Very fresh delicious tapas and great wine list.

reviews.author: Chun Ho Cheng
reviews.text: Overall 4.5/5. Delicious food and atmosphere. Small plates but packed with flavours. Highly recommend the Bikini with jamon serrano and the dessert torrija especially. Slight above average price range. Its a great place for special occasions.

reviews.author: Blair R
reviews.text: Everyone was so friendly and our waitress was so helpful when we asked for advice on the food. We sat on the upper floor by the retractable roof terrace, which was lovely. Would recommend the beef short rib and the harissa chicken. We will definitely come back for me.

reviews.author: T.L
reviews.text: Was told last minute by another restaurant that we weren’t allowed to bring a cake in but thankfully this restaurant was kind enough to accommodate us. The staff were really friendly and gave great recommendations in terms of what to order. We initially thought that the tapas would not be filling enough but thankfully the waiter advised us that our order was a bit too much. The food ended up being quite filling and was very delicious especially the croquetas. We had an amazing experience here and I definitely would go back. Thank you to this place for making my birthday celebration special :)

reviews.author: madison wilson
reviews.text:
We was kindly squeezed into the restaurant last minute before kitchen closed.
Food was beautiful, short rib was so tender and fell apart with just my fork.
Service was also amazing and waiter was really friendly.
Plus very authentic dishes!!
Definitely would recommend!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Darko
reviews.text: On my arrival I walked in as I wanted to take video and one of the workers shouted yes queen, that was so lovely, I got a compliment as well.  Very professional workers, very lovely place, it took as time to get a table, but we eventually got one, they service was a bit slow as we had to wait for a bit to pay. But what a lovely day I had, they food very nice  I ordered sea food meal and I really did enjoy it. It’s because I wanted to taste something different than regular meals and this was fantastic. My sister got a free cake as it was her birthday bomb. Will definitely be going there again.

reviews.author: Murat Baydu
reviews.text:
We’ve just visited Gaucho Manchester, and honestly, it was an outstanding experience.
Despite the restaurant being extremely busy, everything ran smoothly and on time. The service was warm, attentive, and genuinely caring. Our food arrived perfectly timed, and the quality of the starters and mains was far better than we expected.
The desserts seem likely to be pre-prepared, but to be fair, this really didn’t matter — the overall food quality and service easily made up for it.
What impressed us the most was the teamwork. Everyone we interacted with was professional, friendly, and fully engaged. Even in a very busy environment, they still found the time to check in with us and make sure everything was right.
A special thank you to Fletcher, who looked after us  clearly passionate about his job and excellent at what he does.
Also, Hanna, who I believe is the manager, deserves real credit. The restaurant is incredibly well organised, from the kitchen to the floor, and it truly shows.
We travelled all the way from Harrogate, and it was absolutely worth it.
Thank you to the entire team  a great example of how a restaurant should be run. We’ll definitely be back

reviews.author: summer
reviews.text:
I visited Gaucho tonight for my birthday, wearing my red dress, and honestly the whole place matched the vibe – classy, warm and absolutely stunning. From the moment we arrived, the service was perfect. We were looked after by Andrea, who was genuinely one of the best servers I’ve ever had. So friendly, attentive and made me feel so special on my birthday.

I ordered the steak and it was unreal – cooked perfectly, so tender and full of flavour. My partner got the burger and loved every single bite. Everything was beautifully presented and tasted amazing.

To top it all off, they surprised me with a free dessert for my birthday which was such a sweet touch and made the night even more special.

The atmosphere, the service, the food… everything was 10/10. If you’re thinking about going to Gaucho, do it. I’ll definitely be returning!

reviews.author: alex Lea
reviews.text:
I recently visited Gaucho for a Sunday roast and unfortunately the experience didn’t quite live up to the price.

The starter, crab on toast, was actually very nice. The lime worked really well with it and it was a great way to start the meal. However, things started to fall short when the mains arrived.

I had the roast beef Sunday roast. The beef itself was tender and the gravy was lovely, but the roast potatoes and carrots were only lukewarm, which took away from what should have been a comforting dish.

The biggest disappointment though was the chateaubriand, which costs £41 per person. For a premium steak you’d expect a noticeably better portion or overall experience, but the portion size was basically the same as the roast beef but the difference was a bit of green.
Compared to other steakhouses at a similar price point, you usually get far more value and a more impressive serving.

Drinks were also disappointing. Cocktails were around £14 to £15 but arrived with a huge ice cube and very little actual drink, which made them feel like a rip off.

Overall, while there were a couple of positives, the value for money just wasn’t there. For the price, I would honestly rather go somewhere like a more casual pub, or even an independent steakhouse where the portions and pricing feel a lot more reasonable. It will probably be a while before or last time I step foot in a place like this as I went McDonalds after because I was still hungry

reviews.author: Babs
reviews.text: Incredible vibes and even better food! This spot boasts a unique aesthetic and a lively energy that's quintessentially Manchester. The staff are proactive and polished, making you feel right at home. As for the food? The steaks are perfectly seasoned and melt-in-your-mouth. Easily one of the best dining experiences in the city.

reviews.author: YIKAI CAI
reviews.text:
Had a really enjoyable dining experience here. The steak was cooked to perfection — juicy, tender, and complemented by a rich, creamy peppercorn sauce that added just the right depth of flavor. The fresh salad on the side balanced the dish nicely.
We also started with the bread, which was warm and beautifully textured, served with flavorful oil that elevated the whole starter.
What truly stood out, though, was the service. NORA was attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming, making us feel very well taken care of throughout the meal.
A great spot for a quality steak dinner — highly recommended.

reviews.author: Maria Collier
reviews.text: First visit to Gaucho with Virgin gift voucher. Staff were attentive,  friendly and non judgemental. They really were perfect! Food was good portion sizes and also very tasty! The restaurant is due to undergo a refurb so hope to return on our next visit to Manchester.

reviews.author: Arby Lyra
reviews.text:
We were really looking forward to dining at Gaucho, especially given the strong reviews, but our experience fell quite a bit short of expectations.

For starters, we had the cheese & truffle croquettes and the minestrone soup. The croquettes were fine, but the soup was disappointingly bland and didn’t look particularly appetising.

The mains were, unfortunately, the most disappointing part of the meal. We ordered the salmon steak and a 300g ribeye. Both dishes arrived looking and tasting burnt. The salmon skin was completely blackened to the point of being inedible, and we had to remove it entirely. The ribeye was cooked medium inside as requested, but the exterior tasted burnt and some parts were literally black. It’s a shame, because the cut itself seemed like a good piece of meat that just wasn’t treated with the care it deserved.

Dessert was the saving grace. The hot cookie dough was genuinely enjoyable and great for sharing. The scoop of vanilla ice cream was a bit small, but overall the dessert was the highlight of the meal.

When the bill arrived, we noticed a 12.5% gratuity/tip added on top of the service charge by default, which didn’t sit well given the issues with the food. Service itself was decent, and the space looks nice, but the tables are set a little too close to one another.

Overall, we left disappointed, especially considering the reputation and price point.
